Ring.SpecialDescription: Chull is a cold, wind-scoured world of permafrost under a dim red sun. The Chukk clans dug their warrens deep beneath the ice, and every clan keeps a vault there for its plunder. Whoever sits on the Throne of Chukk rules from Chull, for as long as no one cuts their throat.
The Chukk call this blood-red giant the Hoard. It is no place to live, but raiders lie in wait among its broad rings, and the clans hide there whatever plunder they cannot carry home.
